[Unit]
Description=DeepSeek Harness Web
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=dsh
Group=dsh
WorkingDirectory=/srv/dsh/workspaces
Environment=DSH_HOME=/home/dsh/.dsh
Environment=HOME=/home/dsh
Environment=PATH=/opt/node-v24.19.0-linux-x64/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/dsh web --host 127.0.0.1 --port 3080
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5
UMask=0077
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true
ProtectSystem=full
ReadWritePaths=/home/dsh/.dsh /srv/dsh/workspaces

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
